_note: Layer 1 for Leave: statutory leave rules per country, owned by Pebl compliance. Values marked illustrative are placeholders for the demo, not legal advice. Canada is out of scope for Leave: most employees fall under provincial standards, so each province is its own rulebook and requests go to HR.

vacation.description: 5.6 weeks' paid holiday a year (28 days for a 5-day week). Bank holidays can count toward it.

carryover.description: Unused statutory leave lapses at the end of the leave year, apart from what the employer agrees to carry over.

sick.pay: Company sick pay at full rate (Statutory Sick Pay is the floor)
sick.description: Up to 7 days can be self-certified; a fit note is needed after that.

paternity.description: Up to 2 weeks' statutory paternity leave, paid at the statutory rate.

parental.description: Unpaid parental leave, up to 18 weeks per child.

vacation.description: No federal paid-vacation mandate, so vacation is entirely client policy.
vacation.source: US Department of Labor: Vacation leave

carryover.description: Carryover follows client policy (some states restrict forfeiture).

sick.pay: Paid under the company sick policy (state paid-sick-leave laws are the floor)

parental.description: Up to 12 weeks of unpaid, job-protected leave for eligible employees.

vacation.description: At least 20 working days a year for a 5-day week (BUrlG).
vacation.source: Germany: minimum vacation under the BUrlG

carryover.description: Untaken leave carries to 31 March, then lapses only if the employer warned the employee in time.

sick.pay: Full pay for up to 6 weeks (continued pay)
sick.description: A doctor's certificate is needed from the fourth day.

parental.pay: Unpaid by the employer (state parental allowance applies)
parental.description: Parental leave (Elternzeit), up to 3 years per child.

vacation.description: At least 10 days after 6 months' service, rising with tenure; employers must ensure 5 days are taken each year.

carryover.description: Unused days carry over for one year.

sick.pay: Paid under the company sick policy
